name: Input Buffer
description: Clicked a few frames early? Shifts your click to the exact frame that survives.

extra-frames.name: Max Early Frames
extra-frames.description: How many frames early a click can be and still get moved to the frame that survives. 9 frames early with this set to 8 still dies. Higher values cost more per click.

frame-unit.name: Frame Unit
frame-unit.description: What a frame means. 240 = GD physics steps (use for 240 FPS frame perfects). 60 = 60 FPS frames (4 physics steps each).

look-ahead.name: Look-ahead (steps)
look-ahead.description: How far ahead the mod checks that you survive, in physics steps (240 = 1 second). Higher catches more but costs more per click. If clicks stutter, lower this.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Runs levels in test mode so completions and percentages aren't saved while the buffer is on.
